brief: A strawberry tower for a small balcony: one planter three storeys tall in the middle, ringed by six planters two storeys tall. Fill every planter with soil and plant strawberries in all seven, with a fruiting plant in the middle one.

strawberry-harvest (prop:1) in middle bin; strawberry-young in all six ring bins
requirements.requirement: Plant strawberries in all seven, fruiting plant in middle

finish.summary: Strawberry tower: 3-storey centre with drained 3-deep planter holding a fruiting strawberry, ringed by six 2-storey columns each with a drained 2-deep planter with young strawberries. All bins filled with soil, house rules applied, mesh clear.

lines.label: Bin, full depth, drained, 2 stories deep
Bin, full depth, drained, 3 stories deep
Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
